legend: An 84-year-old woman with inverted follicular keratosis mimicking a nodular basal cell carcinoma.

An eyelid covered by skin and conjunctiva is shown. There is nodular inverted proliferation of basaloid and squamoid cells deriving from the follicular infundibulum, with a crypt opening to the surface. There is absence of an infiltrative destructive growth pattern. Intermingled basaloid and squamoid cells are present with focal acantholysis and a squamous eddy.
Higher magnification of a squamous eddy with basaloid cells located at the periphery and squamoid cells at the centre of the lobule. A single mitotic figure is present.
